title: Follow-ups: the app page never sticks busy or draws an old poll, cards patch and keep one identity, the objective sheet and the Displays tray behave
requested_outcome:
Nine follow-ups from the round-12 deploy review, filed as work for the next build under the owner's ship rule of 30 September (docs/product-memory/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-09-30.md). All are on the app page, the cards it draws and the objectives it shows. Fix each so it cannot happen, with a test that fails on the code at the base commit.
- S4A/S4A-01 (web/app.js): a first question asked before the page knows its half leaves the page busy for good. noteBranch moves the turn's in-flight entry from the key '_' to the new branch id, and submit's finally deletes only '_', so syncBusy keeps finding the stranded entry and every later hold and tap is blocked. However a turn's key changes while it is in flight, its own entry must be removed when it ends.
- S4A/S4A-02 (web/app.js startStatePolling/stopStatePolling): stopping the poll clears the interval but not a request already out; when that answer lands during the next turn, the tick checks only the global busy flag and data.known and passes its workspace to applyWorkspace, which can clear the current turn's cards. Each polling run needs its own generation and the half it was for; an answer for a run that has stopped, or for another half, is dropped.
- W1/W1-02 (web/ui.js byRender): a render id built from a title or subject is put into a CSS attribute selector unescaped; a double quote makes querySelectorAll throw and aborts applyPatches and every later patch in that batch. Find the node by comparing dataset.render, or escape correctly.
- AC2/AC2-01 (app/render.py fingerprint, visual_print, RenderLedger.stage): only data and the visual keys are compared, so a card whose visible title, subtitle, linked entities or freshness changed while its data did not is suppressed and the glass keeps stale words. Those envelope fields count.
- AC2/AC2-02 (app/render.py KEY_OF, key_of, render_id): an order keyed by order_id and the same order keyed only by order_number get two render ids, so the same order can stand twice on the glass. One order is one card.
- W2/W2-04 (web/alpha.js, Mark done): a failed status request is caught, then the sheet is closed and the home refreshed as though the objective were done. Keep the sheet open and say why; close and refresh only after the server confirmed.
- S6/S6-05 (app/routes/objectives.py CreateBody, create_objective): the create route accepts kind 'project' or 'tasks' but has no field for their stages or tasks, so both always fail there. Either accept validated stages and tasks and pass them to ObjectiveStore.create, or refuse those kinds on this route with a plain reason before anything is recorded.
- W3/W3-05 (web/lift.css, web/edges.js): the Displays tray's long list (.lift-list.is-long) has a fixed mask that fades both ends even when scrolled fully to one end, against the rule that an edge fades only while there is more beyond it; .lift-list is not among the areas edges.js measures. Make its fade follow the scroll position like the other scrolling areas.
- TW/TW-01 (tests/web/dom-shim.js, tests/web/ui.test.js): the shim answers only single simple selectors, so the working-set and batch-card assertions querySelectorAll('script, img') match nothing and could never fail. Make them able to fail; keep what they assert.

What must not change, in every part of this build: every sentence the owner types or says still goes to the model exactly as said, and nothing here reads, answers or routes a sentence by a word list in front of it (deterministic code may check what the model did, never decide for it); every change to the shop or to email stays behind the owner's hold-to-confirm card, nothing here adds a write or skips staging, confirmation or verification, and reads stay reads; no private business data goes into git, and every name, address and order in a test is invented; no test assertion is weakened (an assertion changed here is made stricter, and the report names each one); the kernel, the gate, secret scanning and the acceptance machinery are untouched, and no protected path is edited (protected tests such as tests/test_compose.py, tests/test_engineering_bridge.py and tests/conftest.py are run, never changed); docs/phase4/TOOL_MATRIX.md is regenerated by the loop and never edited by hand. Plain British English in comments and docstrings that say what is true and why; no placeholder copy, invented defaults or filler.
acceptance_criteria: S4A-01: a node test that runs web/app.js's own text (as tests/web/mic.test.js and tests/web/live-words-page.test.js do) submits a first question with no branch known, answers it with a branch id, and finds the in-flight map empty and busy false once the turn ends; a second question is then accepted. It fails on the base code.

S4A-02: a node test holds a /state answer until after its turn ended and the next turn started (and, separately, until after focus moved to the other half); when it lands, applyWorkspace, setState and the heard words are not touched and the current turn's cards are unchanged. It fails on the base code.

W1-02: byRender finds a node whose render id holds a double quote, a backslash, a closing bracket and other selector characters, and applyPatches applies every patch of a batch in which one id holds them, without throwing.

AC2-01: RenderLedger.stage, given a card whose data is unchanged but whose title, subtitle, linked entities or freshness changed, returns a patch carrying the new item rather than suppressing it; the same item staged twice is still suppressed.

AC2-02: an order staged with order_id and order_number and then staged with only its order_number (and the same in the other order) has one render id, so the second staging is a patch of the first card and never a second added card; two different orders still get two cards.

W2-04: a node test makes Mark done's status request fail: the sheet stays open on that objective and says why, and nothing is refreshed as if it were closed; on success the sheet closes and the home refreshes as before.

S6-05: POST /objectives with kind 'project' and its stages, and with kind 'tasks' and its tasks, either creates that objective with them, or is refused with a 4xx and a plain reason and nothing recorded; a create with no kind or kind 'business' behaves exactly as before.
W3-05: with a Displays list longer than the tray, scrolled to the top there is no top fade, at the bottom no bottom fade and in the middle both; the fixed two-ended mask on .lift-list is gone.

TW-01: the shim answers a comma-separated list of the selectors it already supports (or the two ui.test.js assertions query 'script' and 'img' separately), and a control test proves those queries find a real img and a real script element, so the hostile-text assertions in tests/web/ui.test.js can fail; they are kept, not loosened.

The new node tests are in tests/web/followups-app-page.test.js and are run from tests/test_followups_app_page.py under node, skipped only where node is absent (as tests/test_web_js.py does), with '# fail 0' asserted; that file also runs tests/web/edges.test.js, tests/web/lift.test.js and tests/web/alpha-open.test.js the same way, and holds the render ledger and create-route tests.

Nothing else about the page, the deck, the objective sheet or the Displays tray changes; tests/test_web_js.py, the progressive and turn-surface tests, the objectives tests and tests/test_r13_evidence_index.py still pass.
